schema.description:
Create a new user in the system.
        
        Use this tool to add a new user with the specified details. The system automatically generates
        user_id (incremental: USER_001, USER_002, etc.), user_name (from first.last), and other system fields.
        
        Authentication Requirements:
          - x-itsm-user-token: Optional user authentication token. Validates the requester's identity.
          - API returns 401 Unauthorized if provided token is invalid.
        
        Required Parameters:
          - first_name: User's first name (1-60 characters)
          - last_name: User's last name (1-60 characters)
          - email: User's email address (must be unique and valid format)
          - phone: User's phone number (format: +1-415-555-0101, must be unique)
          - role: User's role (must be one of: admin, manager, agent, reporter)
          - active: Whether the user account is active (true or false)
        
        Optional Parameters:
          - user_name: User login name (generated from first.last if not provided)
          - location_id: Location identifier
        
        Note: The organization ID (org_id) is automatically set from the authenticated user's organization.
        
        Auto-Generated Fields:
          - user_id: Incremental ID (USER_001, USER_002, etc.)
          - user_name: Generated from first_name.last_name (lowercase)
          - static_token: Secure authentication token
          - created_on and updated_on timestamps
          - sys_id and other audit fields
        
        Returns the newly created user object with all fields.
schema.name: add_new_user

active.description: Whether the user account is active

email.description: User's email address (valid email format required)

user_name.description: User login name (generated from first.last if not provided)

schema.description:
List users in the organization.

        Retrieves a list of user objects following Microsoft Graph API v1.0 structure.
        Supports OData query parameters for filtering, sorting, pagination, and field selection.

        This endpoint corresponds to GET /users in Microsoft Graph API.

        OData Query Parameters:
          - _top: Optional. Number of items to return (1-999, default: 100)
          - _skip: Optional. Number of items to skip for pagination (≥0, default: 0)
          - _filter: Optional. OData filter expression with support for:
            * Comparison operators: eq, ne, gt, lt, ge, le
            * String functions: startswith(), endswith(), contains()
            * Logical operators: and, or
            * Examples:
              - "displayName eq 'Alice Johnson'"
              - "displayName eq 'Alice' or displayName eq 'Bob'"
              - "startswith(displayName,'A') and accountEnabled eq true"
          - _orderby: Optional. OData orderby expression (e.g., "displayName asc")
          - _select: Optional. Comma-separated list of properties to return
          - _count: Optional. Include total count in response (true/False)

        Default Properties Returned:
          - businessPhones, displayName, givenName, id, jobTitle, mail,
          - mobilePhone, officeLocation, preferredLanguage, surname, userPrincipalName

        Response Structure:
          - Returns list of users with Microsoft Graph API v1.0 format:
            * @odata.context: Metadata context URL
            * @odata.count: Total count (if _count=true)
            * @odata.nextLink: Next page URL (if more results available)
            * value: Array of user objects

        Authentication:
          - Requires x-teams-access-token header with valid access token
          - Token will be validated against user database

        Status Codes:
          - 200: Success - Users retrieved successfully
          - 400: Bad Request - Invalid query parameters
          - 401: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing access token
          - 500: Internal Server Error
schema.name: list_users

_filter.description: OData filter expression. Supports: eq, ne, gt, lt, ge, le operators; startswith(), endswith(), contains() functions; and, or logical operators. Examples: "displayName eq 'Alice Johnson'", "displayName eq 'Alice' or displayName eq 'Bob'", "startswith(displayName,'A') and accountEnabled eq true"

_orderby.description: OData orderby expression (e.g., "displayName asc" or "createdDateTime desc")

_select.description: Comma-separated list of properties to return (e.g., "displayName,mail,jobTitle")

_skip.description: Number of items to skip for pagination

          - phone: Filter by phone number (format: +1-415-555-0101)
          - role: Filter by role (admin, manager, agent, reporter)

        Returns a list of user objects matching the filters, or all users if no filters provided.

created_before.description: Filter users created before this date (ISO 8601 format)

schema.description:
Send a new notification, scoped to user's organization.
        
        Creates a new notification for the specified HR case and email address.
        
        Required parameters:
        - hr_case_id: HR case ID (must belong to user's organization)
        - email: Recipient email address (must belong to a user in the same organization)
        
        Optional parameters:
        - type: Notification type. Valid types: report, update, alert, reminder, solution_proposal, other (default: other). All lowercase, case-sensitive.
        - status: Notification status. Valid statuses: draft, ready, awaiting_approval, work_in_progress, closed_complete, closed_incomplete, awaiting_acceptance, suspended, cancelled. All lowercase, case-sensitive.
        
        Example payload:
        {
            "hr_case_id": 1,
            "email": "user@example.com",
            "type": "alert",
            "status": "ready"
        }
schema.name: send_notification

status.description: Notification status (draft, ready, awaiting_approval, work_in_progress, closed_complete, closed_incomplete, awaiting_acceptance, suspended, cancelled)

type.description: Notification type (report, update, alert, reminder, solution_proposal, other). Default: other

schema.description:
Update specific fields of an existing user.
        
        Use this tool to update one or more fields of a user identified by user_id.
        At least one field (besides user_id) must be provided. The tool validates that
        the new values are different from current values (idempotency check).
        
        Authentication Requirements:
          - x-itsm-user-token: Optional user authentication token. Validates the requester's identity.
          - API returns 401 Unauthorized if provided token is invalid.
        
        Required Parameter:
          - user_id: Unique identifier of the user to update
        
        Optional Parameters (at least one required):
          - email: Updated email address (must be unique and valid format)
          - first_name: Updated first name (1-60 characters)
          - last_name: Updated last name (1-60 characters)
          - active: Updated active status (true or false)
          - phone: Updated phone number (format: +1-415-555-0101, must be unique)
          - role: Updated role (must be one of: admin, manager, agent, reporter)
          - user_name: Updated user login name (must be unique)
          - company_id: Updated company identifier
          - location_id: Updated location identifier
        
        Note: Updating a field to its current value will result in an error (no changes detected).
        System fields like sys_id, created_on, etc. cannot be directly modified.
        
        Returns the updated user object with all fields.
schema.name: update_user_details

email.description: Updated email address (valid email format required)

user_id.description: User's unique identifier to identify which user to update

user_name.description: Updated user login name (must be unique)
